title: Future Gaming Market: end of the Federal Group gaming monopoly (Tasmania)
summary: From 1 July 2023 Tasmanian hotels and clubs hold gaming machine licences directly, ending the Federal Group's monopoly on machines outside casinos.

instruments.title: Gaming Control Amendment (Future Gaming Market) Act 2021

direction_rationale: Direct licensing removes the upstream monopoly, though a cap on gaming authorities limits entry.
comparison: Victoria's 2012 change as an analogue; other states
